name: b24
description: Provides an API and tooling for integrating Drupal entities with Bitrix24 CRM (leads, deals, contacts, products).
project_description:
This module package provides a basic API and functionality for integration with 1C-Bitrix24 CRM, allowing export from various Drupal entities to Bitrix24 leads, deals and contacts entities. Authentication uses the Bitrix24 local-application OAuth2 flow; a RestManager service wraps the crm.* REST methods and maps Drupal entities to Bitrix24 records via a reference table. Submodules add integrations for Commerce orders/products, core contact forms, Drupal users, UTM marks and Webform submissions.

Note that since April 2025 access to the Bitrix24 REST API is a paid option.
